statement: Degree-eight affine rigidity fails: composing G with z -> z+f(x,y) for quadratic f gives a three-parameter source-shear family, and F_f and F_g are affinely equivalent exactly when g(x,y)=tau^2 f(tau x,tau^-1 y) within this family.
